annotations.title: Find Brands With High Seller Churn

description: Find brands experiencing high seller churn relative to their category. Returns brands where seller_churn_30d_delta_vs_cat_pp >= the specified threshold (default 5pp). Optionally filtered by category. Use when the user asks about 'brands losing sellers', 'high churn brands', or 'seller instability'.

marketplace_id.description: 1 = Amazon UK, 2 = Amazon US (default), 4 = Amazon CA, 5 = Amazon AU, 6 = Amazon DE, 7 = Amazon JP, 8 = Amazon IT, 9 = Amazon FR, 10 = Amazon ES, 11 = Amazon MX, 12 = Amazon BR

max_delta_pp.description: Max delta vs category in percentage points. Omit for no ceiling.

min_delta_pp.description: Min delta vs category in percentage points. Default 5.

scope.description: tracked = only brands on the user's watchlist; universe = all brands. Default universe.

name: find_brands_with_high_seller_churn
